description.p:
With CtrlrX, control any MIDI enabled hardware: synthesizers, drum machines, effects, samplers. Create custom user interfaces for your favorite MIDI devices. Host your device as VST or AU plugins in your favorite DAW or as standalone software.
CtrlrX is based on JUCE audio framework by PACE Anti-Piracy Inc. Audio Unit is a trademark of Apple Computer Inc. VST is a trademark of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH.
